name: Ormolu
description: A mounted ring with a gilt stud at each corner of its setting.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 30% 48%, transparent 48%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 10% 10%, #000 10%, transparent 10%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 90% 10%, #000 10%, transparent 10%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 10% 90%, #000 10%, transparent 10%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 90% 90%, #000 10%, transparent 10%); mask: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 50% 50%, transparent 30%, #000 30% 48%, transparent 48%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 10% 10%, #000 10%, transparent 10%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 90% 10%, #000 10%, transparent 10%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 10% 90%, #000 10%, transparent 10%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 90% 90%, #000 10%, transparent 10%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
